scripts.dev: npm run build -w @printly/contracts && concurrently -k -n web,agent -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w windows-agent"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @printly/contracts && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w windows-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @printly/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @printly/contracts && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w windows-agent
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
